idea-plugin.name: Maekom Mongo Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Maekom Mongo Lens provides a Zero-Config MongoDB & AWS DocumentDB Compass-style GUI directly inside IntelliJ IDEA Community & Ultimate.

  • Zero-Config Spring Boot YAML Discovery: Automatically parses single & multi-document application*.yml files, resolves ${VAR:default} placeholders and .env, and protects PRD environments with Read-Only lock.
  • Compass-Style Query Workspace & Smart Quick Filters: Multi-tab Find workspace with Filter/Project/Sort JSON editors, 5-group context menu with multi-selection Smart Quick Filter (=, !=, $in, $nin, Date $gte~$lte, AND/$or, $exists) & Sort, Smart $in builder, and Document Diff.
  • Read-Only Index Inspector & ESR Query Guide: Accurate MongoDB & AWS DocumentDB IXSCAN/COLLSCAN/UNKNOWN detection, unified cached index viewer, one-click Filter templates, and copy-only ESR createIndex recommendations.
  • AWS DocumentDB-Compatible Multi-Join View & Bidirectional Aggregation Builder: Star & Chain joins (A ⋈ B ⋈ C) with array-of-objects key paths, deterministic post-join paging, Unlimited mode (5,000-doc safety cap), and visual/raw Aggregation pipeline builder.
  • AES Field Decryption, In-App Updater & Real-Time KO/EN UI: Temporary plaintext decryption with auto-masking, GitHub Releases in-app updater, and instant Korean/English switching.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v0.2.3

  • Explain & Unified Index Cache: Hardened multi-tier MongoDB & AWS DocumentDB explain() parsing, explicit UNKNOWN badge with failure tooltip when explain fails, and unified 60s cached index metadata (including index sizes).
  • Read-Only Index Inspector & Query Filter Guide: Click the IXSCAN/COLLSCAN/UNKNOWN badge or right-click any collection in Connections tree to inspect indexes, apply Filter templates, and copy ESR-ordered createIndex recommendations (strictly read-only).
  • 5-Group Context Menu & Multi-Selection Smart Quick Filter/Sort: Reorganized Tree & Table right-click menus with automatic single/multi-cell =, !=, $in, $nin, Date range $gte~$lte, multi-field AND/$or (safe $and wrapping), $exists, and quick Sort.
  • Join View Fixes & Limit Modes: Added array-of-objects dot-notation join keys (e.g. items.product_id), fixed post-join deterministic $sort/$skip/$limit(N+1) paging consistency, and added explicit 20 / 50 / 100 / 500 / Unlimited (5,000 cap) modes.
  • Visual Hierarchy Upgrade: Added active bottom-accent mode tabs (Documents (Find) / Aggregations / Mongo Shell) and an icon-backed segmented control for Tree / Table / JSON.
